label: Kimi K3.1 Pro
output:
**To: Bethan Rees**  
**Subject: Re: Nia's hen - Tenby final plan + money!!**

Bethan,

Before you write the whole weekend off, will you just think about one thing for me? And this is only to you — I haven’t replied to the group.

Nia rang me in tears last week asking whether you were still coming. She doesn’t know you’ve pulled out. You’re not just another name on the cottage booking to her. You sat with her at the Heath every single night when her mam was bad in 2019. She’ll remember that forever, and she’ll feel it if you’re not there.

I know November at Lowri’s 40th was awful, with what was said about her ex and everything that came after. I’m not taking sides or saying either of you was right — you both said things. But I honestly think Lowri is sorry underneath it all. She’s stubborn, and you can be too, and I’d hate for that to be what keeps you away.

You don’t have to do the whole weekend. Skip Friday at the cottage and the paddleboarding altogether if you want. Just come down on Saturday for six and be there for the meal. The train from Cardiff Central is about two and a half hours, and I’ll pick you up from Tenby station whenever you get in. You can kip in with me on Saturday night too — I’ve got the twin room, so there’s no issue there. No weekend trapped in a cottage pretending everything’s fine, just Saturday evening with Nia.

You know I swapped my Orlando trip with Kerry to get this weekend off, and that night stop cost me, because I really wanted it. I’m not throwing that at you — I’m just saying this weekend matters, and it won’t feel the same with you missing.

I know you’ll see Nia at Margam on 17th April, and you’re doing a reading, but I think you’ll regret letting the hen go over this.

And don’t send Lowri the £85 yet. Just leave the money for now and don’t make anything final today.

Please think about Saturday. I’ll collect you, you’ll have your space with me, and we’ll take the rest as it comes.

Siân xx
